additionalDestinations.description: List of destinations for which a backup should be created of this backup. Only applicable for snapshot backups.

type.description: The type of backup destination to use

scheduling.description: Schedule for the backup.

day.description: An array of days of the week when the backup should be performed, where `0` represents Monday and `6` represents Sunday. On these days, a backup will be performed at each of the minutes provided in the `minute` field whenever it is an hour from the `hour` field. Required for `weekly` intervals and unavailable for `hourly` and `daily` intervals.

items.description: A day of the week when the backup should be performed, where `0` represents Monday and `6` represents Sunday.

items.description: An hour when the backup should be performed, in 24 hour format.

interval.description: The interval between backups. Each addon can only have one backup schedule of each interval for each backup type.

minute.description: An array of minutes when the backup should be performed.

items.description: A minute when the backup should be performed.

It tracks `paas.price`, so a `teamId`/`projectId`/`resourceType` filter does NOT reduce it — the filter narrows the breakdown under `paas.teams[]` while `paas.price` stays the hour's full PaaS total, and only the customer-level categories drop out. get.description: Lists the per-replica statefulSet volumes for the given service.

volumes.description: The per-replica statefulSet volumes grouped by volume definition.

cleanupPending.description: True when the group's definition is already purged and the background reaper owns removing the retained PVCs — no manual delete is possible (its replicas report deletable: false).

definitionMissing.description: True when the volume definition no longer exists. Its retained PVCs remain individually deletable, but the group DELETE endpoint cannot target the missing definition.

id.description: The user-facing slug of the volume definition, or null when the definition has already been purged but a retained PVC is still being reported.

pendingDelete.description: True if the volume has been removed from the service and only its retained orphaned PVCs remain. When definitionMissing is false, the group can be fully deleted via the group DELETE endpoint; definition-missing groups are reclaimed by background cleanup.

replicas.description: The per-replica PVCs of this volume.

deletable.description: True if the PVC can be deleted now via the per-replica DELETE endpoint: it is orphaned (its volume was removed or its ordinal is scaled down) AND its volume definition still exists. Bound PVCs are refused with 409; claims of a purged volume are false (see group cleanupPending).

ordinal.description: The statefulSet replica ordinal this PVC belongs to.

pvcName.description: The name of the per-replica PVC.

slug.description: Best-effort display slug for a purged (definitionMissing) group, recovered from the PVC labels so the group keeps its original name. Equal to `id` when the definition exists.

200.description: The list of per-replica volumes for the service.

delete.description: Fully deletes a removed per-replica statefulSet volume for the given service: all of its orphaned PVCs and the volume definition. The volume must first be removed from the service.
Deletes one orphaned per-replica statefulSet volume PVC — a scaled-down ordinal, or a replica of a removed volume. Replicas still bound to a running instance are refused with 409.
